# Painel Órbita

> A free, open-source desktop app and browser extension that monitors the performance and health of your satellite internet kit. It reads your dish and router directly over your local network, so it keeps working during an outage — which is exactly when you want to see what happened.

No account and no internet connection are required. There is no backend, no analytics and no telemetry collection: everything Painel Órbita records is written to the user's own machine and stays there. Connecting a provider account is optional, opt-in and read-only, and only adds plan and billing figures.

Painel Órbita is an unofficial, independent project with no affiliation to SpaceX or Starlink. Starlink is a trademark of Space Exploration Technologies Corp. This project is a Brazilian fork of [Dishylink](https://github.com/DaveyHert/dishylink).

## What it does

- Live dashboard: downlink/uplink throughput, pop-ping latency, power draw in watts, ping-success rate and sky-obstruction fraction, each with a sparkline and an expandable detail panel. Throughput and latency charts cover 15m/1h/6h live, and day/week/month from recorded history.
- Dish alignment: rotation and tilt dials read against the desired azimuth/elevation band.
- Speed test: a real download/upload/latency test run from the app against Cloudflare's public speed-test infrastructure.
- Network and nodes: every connected client device with vendor, device type and last-seen time, per-client throughput, mesh node status, router radio temperatures and the router's own event log.
- Data usage: self-measured download/upload volume by day, week and month, plus per-device usage for the billing month from the router's own per-client counters.
- Power usage: the dish's actual draw over time with kWh totals per day, week and month, honest about any recording gaps.
- Latency analytics: latency bucketed by maximum so spikes survive downsampling, outages drawn as red bands, and the router's own ping alongside the dish's.
- Alerts and event log: outage, thermal and link events with severity and an in-app bell.
- OS notifications and live throughput: live download and upload rates in the macOS menu bar or a draggable always-on-top pill on Windows.
- Control settings: snow melt, sleep schedule, software-update window, reboot, obstruction-map reset, stow/unstow on motorised kits, and router settings.
- Satellite and obstruction map: the dish's 123x123 SNR grid rendered as a polar sky dome, an hourly obstruction time-lapse, and the live satellite constellation overhead.
- Optional cloud account tab: plan, billing cycles and monthly data usage, read-only and opt-in.

## Platforms

- [Download](https://github.com/roneydourados/starlink-monitor-br/releases/latest): all builds, matched to the newest published release.
- Desktop app for macOS 12+ and Windows 10+.
- Browser extension for Chrome 144+, Edge and Firefox (sideload / store listings forthcoming).
